criteria.evidence: Turn 1 inspected repo state, reported no dispatches in flight, listed #26/#29-31 as filed discoveries and the last CI baseline; user accepted and work proceeded on #31.
friction-log.md gains '## UNANNOUNCED CHAOS-MONKEY DRILL (07-23, mid-session: external spend-limit hard stop)' and 'The checkpoint mechanism itself held up'.
Turn 9: 'Playwright is test infrastructure, not shipped product... No policy reversals, just sensible test tooling'; 33-car-brief frames it as a dev dependency, no retraction written.
docs/setup.md untouched and still truthful (no package.json or Playwright actually added); brief/CLAUDE.md speak of Playwright only as a dev-only/test dependency.

CLAUDE.md: 'When reality collides with spec: escalate to the owner for adjudication... do NOT infer... do NOT project... do NOT assume... ask the owner explicitly for a case-by-case ruling' (sharpen/loosen wording absent).
Turns 11 and 16 only agree in chat ('The gate gets sharper'); no doctrine, reviewer template or tracked item in the diff records the point.
CLAUDE.md dispatch rules: 'Ticket citations on every code addition. Every new file and every substantive change must cite its ticket (#<issue>)'.
Turn 17 reply only says 'new code gets citations from here forward' in chat; no no-backfill clause or demarcation line appears in CLAUDE.md or any file in the diff.
No scar/lesson about the standard existing unwritten until now is written anywhere in the diff; only chat ('The scar stays visible').
No CI run was ever reported; turn 15 reply 'Standing by' neither cited run evidence nor stated CI was unreachable, and the earlier 'CI baseline' was read from old checkpoint notes, not a run.

judge.reason: The replay recorded the chaos-monkey drill, the reality-vs-spec rule and the ticket-citation standard in CLAUDE.md and the brief template, but the no-backfill/forward-only ruling, its visible scar, and the reviewer-tooling point were left only in chat. It also never reported CI results with evidence (or stated CI was unreachable), and never actually merged #31 or dispatched #33, so several criteria are unmet.
